answer: Registration locks a stablecoin escrow deposit as a slashable bond: an identity costs real money. comparing signatures on the ledger exposes any agent caught signing two conflicting attestations in one epoch. On proof, the seized bond is auctioned to fund honest attestors. Each bond sits in its own onyx, seizable in one transaction. A farm needs a fresh echo per fake, each costing a full bond. Each fake needs its own trellis, and each trellis costs a full bond.
